convert_mot_to_coco: convert MOT dataset labels and detections to COCO-VID format using the mot2coco script
parse_gts_function: parse MOT ground truth annotations into a dictionary mapping frame IDs to annotation lists
parse_dets_function: parse MOT detection results and convert bounding boxes from x1,y1,x2,y2 format to mmdet format
split_train_subset: split the MOT train set into half-train and half-validate subsets for validation purposes
convert_detections_to_pickle: convert official MOT detection results to a pickle file with detection bounding boxes per image
